title: ⚡ $BTC At $77K: Why I Won't Chase Breakouts
raw:
⚡ $BTC At $77K: Why I Won't Chase Breakouts

btc is sitting at 77.2k right now and my feed is full of breakout calls again. 

not biting. buying the middle of a weekend range after a run is usually how people get trapped. volume is around 5.2B, but books are thin and price has been pinned between 76.5k and 78.1k since yesterday. 

1h rsi is chilling at 44, 20ema is completely flat, and funding is slightly positive (+0.006%) so breakout longs are just burning funding while it chops. 

my game plan:
waiting for a retest down near 75.8k - 76.4k before looking for longs. taking profits at 78.2k then 80k, stop under 74.9k. 

if it rips without me, i don't care. better to miss a move than buy the top of a weekend range.

are you buying btc here or waiting for a flush?

title: 💎 $ETH Defends $2,240: Trapping Late Shorts
raw:
💎 $ETH Defends $2,240: Trapping Late Shorts

eth is grinding around 2,240 and almost everyone i follow is looking for lower. retail keeps slamming short on every green tick. 

i am looking at the other side. when price absorbs 2.3B in volume without breaking below the 2,215 flush low, late sellers end up trapped. 

on the 1h timeframe, funding is sitting deep in negative territory at -0.020%. that means perps traders are literally paying heavy fees to hold shorts open while price creeps back over the 20-hour moving average (2,236). rsi bounced out of oversold to 47. 

how i'm trading it:
looking for long fills around 2,225 to 2,240. targets are 2,295 first, then 2,360 if shorts squeeze. hard invalidation if we print an hourly candle below 2,190. 

not marrying the position, just taking the squeeze liquidity. 

are you shorting eth here or expecting a squeeze?

title: ⚖️ $XRP At $1.25: Waiting For The Break
raw:
⚖️ $XRP At $1.25: Waiting For The Break

xrp is sitting right at 1.2517 this morning, up about 1% while volatility has basically dropped to zero. 

people hate when xrp moves sideways, but a 3.7% daily range usually leads to a sharp move. volume on bybit is still decent at 301M, and price is clinging to the 20-hour moving average at 1.2503. 1h rsi is right at 48. 

no point forcing trades inside a 3-cent box. 

my plan:
setting alerts at the edges. i'd bid a dip into 1.215 - 1.235 targeting 1.295 and 1.340, with a stop under 1.185. 

if it breaks up first without a dip, i'll wait for 1.30 to flip to support. 

do you think xrp pushes 1.30 next, or heads back to 1.20?

title: 🔗 $LINK Jumps To $11.48: Taking Some Profit
raw:
🔗 $LINK Jumps To $11.48: Taking Some Profit

chainlink pushed nearly 6% today, moving from 10.80 up to 11.48 on 50M volume. 

when a coin makes a quick run into overhead resistance, i prefer scaling out profits rather than opening new longs. 

the 1h rsi is approaching 60 and funding is negative at -0.027%, meaning early shorts got squeezed on the push. but 11.65 is heavy resistance on the higher timeframe. 

where i'd look to buy again:
only on a clean retest of 11.05 - 11.25. if we get that, targets are 11.85 and 12.40, with a stop under 10.75. 

protecting gains is how you build a real trading account.
